name: The Shift — Queue Mode Reel
tagline: Every current Queue mode as a standalone hit — closing on The Sweep schematic.
audience: PTCB students · pharmacy educators · social media · product demos
estimatedSecNote: Actual duration is driven by ElevenLabs per-line synthesis in DemoForge

steps.narration: The Shift doesn't just quiz you. It mixes live game modes into one adaptive session — let's walk each one.
MCQ and Streak for recall. Blueprints, Matrix, Minefield, Polarity, Drop for the mechanics. The Sweep for the prestige close.
Blueprints — a real workflow, scrambled into steps. Rebuild it in the correct order.
The Matrix — structure the setup. Every tile has a home; lock the clean structure.
The Minefield — a grid of clinical hazards. Navigate clean or the breach fails.
Polarity — secure the network. Engage a node, answer the volley, keep the link alive.
The Drop — match the falling term before it crosses the capture line.
The Sweep — the main schematic. Zone-by-zone defect hunt. Prestige closer for the weekly ladder — and the shot that sticks.
The Queue sequences all of it automatically. One session. Every mode. Zero manual setup.
